#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353LL;

long long modPow(long long base, long long exp) {
    long long result = 1LL;
    long long factor = base % MOD;
    while (exp > 0LL) {
        if (exp & 1LL) {
            result = (result * factor) % MOD;
        }
        factor = (factor * factor) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    string line;
    getline(cin, line);
    stringstream ss(line);

    long long N, M, L, R;
    ss >> N >> M >> L >> R;

    long long area = N * M;
    long long length = R - L + 1;
    long long value = modPow(length, area);

    if (area % 2 == 1) {
        cout << value << "\n";
    } else if (length % 2 == 0) {
        cout << (value * ((MOD + 1) / 2) % MOD) << "\n";
    } else {
        cout << ((value + 1) * ((MOD + 1) / 2) % MOD) << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}
